description: Extra destinations of a hosted website's Backsies backups (up to 10, any mix of the customer's own S3-compatible storage and Google Drive; the same bucket or account twice is refused; needs an active Backsies licence, OMA checks it). After each backup its snapshots are copied to every destination in turn; the site is not read again. action get (default) lists them with ids; set adds S3 storage (endpoint, region, bucket, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey; tested before saving); remove removes one (destinationId; backups already there stay); recovery shows one destination's restic repository and password for using it without Lanetti (destinationId); connect_cloud (provider gdrive, optional returnUrl on OMA or the site) returns a Google sign-in link: after the customer allows access their Drive is added. set, remove and recovery need confirmation.

accessKeyId.description: set: leave out with secretAccessKey to keep the saved keys.

action.description: get (default) reads the extra destination; set adds storage; remove removes it; recovery shows the restic repository and password; connect_cloud returns a Google Drive sign-in link for the customer.

destinationId.description: remove / recovery: which extra destination (id from get); optional when there is only one.

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

endpoint.description: set: public https S3 endpoint, e.g. https://s3.eu-central-003.backblazeb2.com.

provider.description: connect_cloud: cloud drive (list shows which are available in clouds).

returnUrl.description: connect_cloud: where the browser returns after sign-in (OMA or the site).

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

name: oma_backsies_copy
title: Backsies extra destination
